title: Evidence API: add UI workbench (dataset-scoped evidence finder)
description: Add a first-class UI page that calls POST /api/v1/rag/retrieve and visualizes citations, scores, abstain/has_evidence, and filters (dataset_id, doc_ids, metadata).

title: Eval: per-dataset retrieval SLO baselines + reports
description: Extend retrieval-only regression gate to support per-dataset exported bundles + thresholds, generate summary reports (Hit@K/Recall@K/MRR/NDCG), and provide a workflow to update baselines safely.

title: Chunking/KG: structure-aware chunking + KG extraction linkage
description: Upgrade chunking to preserve structure (header_path, tables, parent-child) and extract KG (entities/relations) linked to chunk_id. Support KG-based retrieval injection and provenance tracking.

title: Parsing QA: document parse quality scoring + retries
description: Harden doc parsing stage: per-parser quality metrics (text density, OCR confidence, layout coverage), failure taxonomy, auto-retry/backoff, and quarantining. Persist signals in doc_metadata and expose in dataset profile.

title: MinIO: support file:// and path unquote for inline image refs
description: Finish docs/rag_image_minio_integration_tasks.md #13: make inline image uploader handle MarkItDown-style local image refs including file:// URLs and URL-escaped paths; add tests.
close_reason: Added file:// + percent-unquote support for inline/local image refs (MarkItDown) and covered with unit tests; marked task #13 complete.

title: Eval Gate: retrieval regression SLO (hit@k / recall@k)
description: Add a regression gate that fails CI when retrieval hit@k/recall drops below per-dataset baselines; integrate with existing regression cases + metrics.
close_reason: Added deterministic retrieval SLO regression gate (hit@20/recall) as CI test using existing regression metrics.

title: Query expansion for recall (aliases/synonyms + multi-query presets)
description: Add a controlled query expansion layer for retrieval: dataset-scoped alias/synonym dictionary + optional multi-query generation (already exists globally; make it per-dataset/per-request). Log expansions in retrieval trace and evaluate via retrieval-only regression gate (Hit@20/MRR/NDCG@20).

title: Retrieval: add persistent lexical fallback (Postgres FTS/trigram)
description: Add a persistent sparse retrieval channel (Postgres full-text or pg_trgm) to reduce false negatives for numbers, codes, and exact phrases; fuse with dense + BM25 via RRF.
close_reason: Implemented Postgres FTS + pg_trgm lexical channel and fused with dense/BM25.

title: MinIO: add backfill/reprocess workflow for historical documents
description: Finish docs/rag_image_minio_integration_tasks.md #18: add a documented workflow (script or API usage) to reprocess historical documents so chunks backfill img_id when MinIO is enabled.
close_reason: Added scripts/backfill_minio_images.py to batch retry documents and backfill MinIO img_id; documented workflow and marked task #18 complete.

title: Evidence API: update OpenAPI + frontend client types
description: Ensure new /api/v1/rag/retrieve endpoint appears in OpenAPI; refresh web/openapi.json and any generated client types.

title: MinIO: document and harden image-url auth/tenant checks
description: Finish docs/rag_image_minio_integration_tasks.md #20: document and, if needed, harden /api/v1/documents/image-url/{img_id} auth/tenant checks (JWT mode requires auth/token; header mode dev behavior). Add tests for key cases.
close_reason: Documented image-url auth expectations and added unit tests for jwt/header production + tenant mismatch; marked task #20 complete.

title: Retrieval Excellence: Evidence API + coverage retrieval profiles
description: Add production retrieval-only endpoint (no generation) and multiple recall/coverage retrieval profiles (beyond recall20). Include tests + docs. Goal: maximize recall so if data exists in corpus it is retrievable.

title: Ingestion: dataset distribution scan + visualization
description: Add dataset-scoped profiling to visualize ingestion health: docs/chunks counts, file types, page ranges, token/char histograms, language mix, parse quality score distribution, and drill-down to outliers. Surface in UI + API, and export snapshots for audits.

title: Retrieval recall@20 runtime profile (top_k=20, threshold=0, no diversity caps)
description: Create a retrieval-first config preset (recall20) that guarantees chunk-level Hit@20 as primary objective: default top_k=20, score_threshold=0, disable dedup and per-doc diversity caps in recall mode, keep hybrid (vector+BM25) with overfetch. Expose via /rag/retrieve-preview defaults + dataset rag_defaults + (optional) chat override. Add regression cases + CI gate thresholds (retrieval_hit_at_20=1.0).

title: Strict evidence-only RAG mode (per request + dataset defaults)
description: Add a strict grounding mode that enforces 'visible evidence only' semantics per chat request and via dataset rag_defaults. When enabled: force abstain on weak evidence, run post-gen claim check, and ensure structured_output is also verified (no hallucinated fields). Expose as ChatRAGConfig + DatasetRAGDefaults fields and propagate through LangChain engine + LangGraph pipeline. Add tests + docs.

title: MinIO: monitoring/reporting for put/presign failures + object growth
description: Finish docs/rag_image_minio_integration_tasks.md #19: add monitoring/reporting guidance for MinIO put/presign failures and object growth; ship a small script that summarizes MINIO_METRICS_LOG_PATH JSONL and (optionally) bucket stats.
close_reason: Added scripts/minio_metrics_report.py and documented MINIO_METRICS_LOG_PATH-based monitoring + optional bucket stats; marked task #19 complete.

title: MinIO: align env/docs with docker compose
description: Finish docs/rag_image_minio_integration_tasks.md #1-3 by aligning root .env.example + docs/minio_integration.md with current docker/docker-compose.yml service names (mimirq-minio/mimirq-redis/mimirq-milvus) and providing a quick local MinIO verification path.
close_reason: Aligned root .env.example DOCKER service names and updated MinIO integration docs; marked tasks 1-3 complete.

title: MinIO: define image display strategy (citations vs context)
description: Finish docs/rag_image_minio_integration_tasks.md #17: define and document the chat image display policy (what counts as a cited image; caps; where shown) and ensure it matches backend+frontend behavior.
close_reason: Documented current chat image display policy (citations-only + optional answer append via SHOW_IMAGE_IN_ANSWER/IMAGE_APPEND_MAX); marked task #17 complete.

title: BM25/tokenization upgrades for recall (zh char-ngrams, numbers, paths)
description: Improve tokenize_for_bm25 to reduce false negatives: add optional zh character bigram/edge-ngram fallback for OOV; preserve tokens for versions/paths/identifiers; add numeric normalization tokens. Keep it configurable and benchmark with retrieval-only regression gate (Hit@20).

title: Governance: markdown normalization + PII/secrets scanning pipeline
description: Implement governance layer over parsed markdown: normalization, rule packs (PII/secrets/license), redaction/quarantine actions, and dataset-level governance profiles with versioning + reports.
